spec: docs/design/13-asset-pipeline.md §6 (Concept Art -- one concept sheet per asset set, two human gates)
rooms_source: docs/design/14-vertical-slice.md §10 (seven rooms: Ground Relay, Records Room, Power Substation, Equipment Floor, Storage Cache, Antenna Shaft, Broadcast Deck)
note: This table is generated once by hand as part of the T-0226 audit, not regenerated by a script -- it is a documentation artifact, not AI-generated art. Every 'approved' field below is hard-coded false: direction approval is a human gate (§6 'two human gates, not one'), and this card parks for that verdict rather than asserting it (see test_signal_tower_concept_audit.py::test_audit_table_no_row_self_asserts_approval).

asset_sets.description: Concrete wall/floor base fields + wall-floor transitions dressing every room's structural surfaces.
asset_sets.note: Card body lists this as existing on develop. DL-15 (docs/decision-log.md) records an agent's own analytical 'direction CONFIRMED' verdict for the T-0072 LoRA handshake against this sheet -- not a human sign-off. No decision-log entry records an actual human approving this sheet's direction, despite downstream generation (palette extraction, tile bake) already having happened against it. T-0226 also found and fixed a real bug here: this sheet's provenance concept_hash previously held the sha256 of the *input template*, not the output sheet -- see .provenance.json's _t0226_fix note.

asset_sets.description: Supplementary tile-detail sheet: relay rack, institutional-green control panel, pipe conduit, plus a second wall/floor/trim pass in spec-conformant framing (T-0104 round-2).
asset_sets.note: Present on develop (commit 491725b, 'round-2 concept sheets, spec-conformant framing') but NOT listed in this card's own body alongside the material sheet / T-0209 / T-0210 / T-0211 -- the card's own enumeration of 'what already exists' was incomplete. No decision-log entry records approval. Flagged here so §23-d/e/f cite the complete set, not the card body's partial one.

asset_sets.description: Player idle / walk / crouch-hide / scale reference. Shared across every room and across Track 1's three bake-off arms.
asset_sets.note: T-0226's parent card (this one) describes this sheet as '(approved; also Track 1's shared reference for all three arms)'. No decision-log entry recording an actual human verdict was found. Downstream sprite generation (T-0212 and later) already happened against it. Recorded here as pending, not approved, until a human confirms on this card -- the parent card's prose is not itself the recorded verdict this AC requires.

asset_sets.description: Watcher / Sound / Still Air, each with idle / move / trapped reference panels.
asset_sets.note: No decision-log entry records a human approval verdict for this sheet, despite T-0214's downstream entity-sprite generation already having happened against it.

asset_sets.description: Cover props (relay cabinet, crate stack, low duct) and hiding-spot props (locker, server rack).
asset_sets.note: No decision-log entry records a human approval verdict, despite T-0221/T-0223's downstream prop-sprite generation already having happened against it.

asset_sets.description: Power Substation's breaker/control panel along the back wall and 2-3 transformer housings used as cover (`14` §10 room table).
asset_sets.note: The breaker/control panel is directly covered by tile_material_detail's 'institutional green control panel with switches' panel. 'Transformer housing' has no dedicated panel -- this audit treats it as visually equivalent to cover_and_hiding_props' 'wide squat relay junction cabinet' (same industrial-cabinet silhouette class). This equivalence is a judgment call made by this audit, not a generated sheet, and should be confirmed by a human alongside the direction-approval verdicts above -- if rejected, transformer housing becomes its own missing row.

asset_sets.description: Dense records-office shelving rows dressing the Records Room (`14` §10: 'Smaller, dense shelving rows (records-office dressing)').
asset_sets.note: MISSING before this card -- no existing sheet covered records shelving. Generated through T-0104's committed concept workflow (assets/src/concept/_comfyui_structure_workflow.json, real ComfyUI SDXL output, not a synthetic placeholder) as panel one of the new signal_tower_structure_concept_sheet_v1.png. Regenerated once already during this card's own review cycle: the first submission was a bare txt2img prompt that violated the archetype-first coherence guard (`13` §6, lines 313-319) and rendered a receding-perspective interior scene instead of flat elevation panels. Current sheet is img2img+LoRA, denoise 0.88, conditioned on signal_tower_material_sheet.png (the archetype's first approved sheet) -- see the sheet's own provenance `_t0226_coherence_fix` note.

asset_sets.description: The vertical-connector ladder used between every room on the climb (`14` §10 room graph; `11` §2: 'Ladder ... free, always-usable, part of base layout -- same status as a normal door').
asset_sets.note: MISSING before this card -- the ladder mechanic is archetype-generic (`11` §2) but its art must stay coherent with the Signal Tower's own approved direction (§6 archetype-first coherence guard), so it still needed its own Signal-Tower-styled reference. Generated as panel two of signal_tower_structure_concept_sheet_v1.png, regenerated img2img-conditioned on the material sheet -- see records_room_shelving's note above for why.

asset_sets.description: The short elevated catwalk the Watcher is fixed on (`14` §10: 'Watcher fixed on a short catwalk').
asset_sets.note: MISSING before this card -- no existing tile or prop sheet covered an elevated grating platform. Generated as panel three of signal_tower_structure_concept_sheet_v1.png, regenerated img2img-conditioned on the material sheet -- see records_room_shelving's note above for why.

asset_sets.description: Single branch doors dead-ending back to their parent room (`14` §10: 'Branches are single doors, dead-ending back to their parent room').
asset_sets.note: MISSING from this card's own first pass -- doors were never given a row despite `14` line 142 making them a required branch-dressing element, and despite ladder_traversal's own justification above ('same status as a normal door', `11` §2) implying the same obligation for the door itself. Records Room and Storage Cache are the two branch rooms in the room graph (`14` §10); Ground Relay and Equipment Floor are their respective parent rooms the door sits between. Generated as panel four of signal_tower_structure_concept_sheet_v1.png, img2img-conditioned on the material sheet.

asset_sets.description: The Broadcast Deck's chain tear, described as a 'chroma-lit centerpiece' (`14` §10).
asset_sets.note: Not a concept-art asset set. 'Chroma-lit' is the chroma mechanic (docs/design/01-vision.md §8): a runtime palette-swap shader keyed on origin_palette (13-asset-pipeline.md §4, line ~65), tracked as A-4 'Chroma-intensity shader ramp vs. collapse proximity' (Phase 6, 13-asset-pipeline.md §7 Open). The tear itself reuses the anchor-tag mechanism (docs/design/12-tears.md) -- no static sprite/sheet is implied by the design docs. If a future pass art-directs a physical tear-frame prop distinct from the shader effect, this row should be revisited and a concept sheet added.
